## Key Differentiators
1. **Fixed quote before work** — No hidden charges, price confirmed upfront
2. **Insured & verified crew** — Background-verified tradesmen, publicly insured
3. **Transparent warranty** — Written warranty on workmanship (30 days to 5 years depending on service)
4. **Same-day dispatch** — KL & Selangor, bookings before 11 AM get same-day service
5. **Premium materials** — Nippon Paint, Dulux, Kohler, American Standard, Rubine, Panasonic
6. **Professional-grade equipment** — Industrial sprayers, laser levels, pipe inspection cameras
7. **Post-service cleanup** — Every team restores the work area to its original condition

## Pricing Philosophy
Market-rate pricing benchmarked against the Klang Valley home services market. We never inflate and then discount — our quotes are genuine market rates. Volume discounts available for multi-room or multi-service projects.
